## Activity

During November 2020, North City Eye Clinic recorded 330 captures. This provides the activity total for the reporting month and indicates the volume submitted for image assessment and subsequent grading. The capture activity is reported as a monthly total for the site.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 9 were classified as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 2.7. This measure records the proportion of submitted images that could not be used for assessment. The result should be considered alongside the total capture activity when reviewing image quality at North City Eye Clinic.

## Grading

Grading identified 55 referable results during November 2020. These results represent images requiring referral in accordance with the grading outcome. The median lag from capture to grading was 1. This records the central turnaround time for graded images during the month. Together, the referable result count and median lag provide a summary of grading activity and timeliness for the reporting period.
